text:
anya: quick heads-up — saturn-lite-v2-q5 (canary) multilang smoke showed a weird token merge when Japanese vertical blocks include inline RTL captions. small BLEU drop on the vertical-jp+ar slice (~1.9). :frowning:
rui: can you paste a minimal failing example?
anya: sure, here's one I pulled from the mixed-orient subset:
```
VERT_BLOCK:
漢(かんじ)
CAPTION: بالبدا test
```
expected detok: "Kanji (kanji) ... Caption: al-bada test"
observed detok: "Kanji(かんじ)بالبدا test" (ruby fused onto Arabic token)
sam: which tokenizer + normalize flags? fast-tokenizer v4? joiner?
anya: tokenizer=fast-v4, normalize=nfkc+ruby-opt, quant-path=q5-int-ish, kernel=auto. ran with --tokenizer-debug=true.
eval-bot: metric snapshot (vertical_jp_ar subset): BLEU_base=35.0 -> 33.1, chrF=0.66 -> 0.63, token-boundary-anom +1.7%
rui: sounds like ruby-opt coalescing across script boundary, and detok bidi step didn't insert an LRM/FSI after ruby marker. could be two interacting changes (tokenizer coalesce + detok bidi).
anya: bisected locally: repro only fails when both fast-v4 ruby-opt enabled AND runtime detok uses bidi-simplify=true. either one alone is fine.
sam: can you share the repro command?
anya: repro I ran on canary machine:
```bash
python tests/repro_vertical_mixed.py \
  --model saturn-lite-v2-q5 --subset vertical_jp_ar \
  --no-batch --seed 7 --tokenizer fast-v4 --tokenizer-debug true \
  > /tmp/saturn_vq5_vert_debug.out
```
rui: i'll run that and post token id stream diffs. quick mitigation: flip ruby-opt off for canary or toggle detok bidi to keep explicit reset characters. which is faster?
anya: ruby-opt toggle is a config flip, no model push. deploy-bot: disable ruby_opt on saturn-lite-v2-q5 canary pool?
deploy-bot: Received. Setting tokenizer.ruby_opt=false for saturn-lite-v2-q5 canary. Rollout in ~60s. :gear:
ci-bot: note: fast-v4 rollout is behind feature flag TK_FAST_V4; canary currently has TK_FAST_V4=true.
eval-bot: preliminary after-toggle snapshot: BLEU_canary=34.0, chrF=0.645, token-boundary-anom 0.9% (improving). full run pending.
sam: if toggle fixes it, add unit test to tokenizer suite: tests/tokenizer_unit/test_vertical_ruby_rtl.py with mixed ruby+Arabic case. Also add an onboarding gate: "vertical+rtl smoke" for quant bring-up.
anya: agreed. i'll open PR with test + docs in docs/onboarding/quant_playbook.md noting this interaction. assigning: rui (repro + token-diff), sam (test + gate), anya (PR + ticket).
rui: running repro now, will paste tokenized dump in ~8m. :eyes:
anya: tagging @eng-ml for visibility. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
